title: AWKUM Announces ETEA Screening Test Schedule for Lecturer Positions in English & Pharmacy Advertisement No. 62 (2025)
text:
Written Screening Test Notice (Lecturer - English & Pharmacy)

All applicants for the position of
Lecturer (English & Pharmacy)
at

Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan
, who applied in response to

Advertisement No. 62 (2025)
published on
September 6, 2025
,
and have been declared eligible by the
Scrutiny & Quantification Committee
,
are hereby informed that the written screening (computer-based) test will be conducted as per the following details:

Testing Agency:
Educational Testing & Evaluation Agency (ETEA)

Date:
Sunday, April 5, 2026

Venue:
HIMALAYA COLLEGE OF NURSING & ALLIED HEALTH SCIENCES, Mardan

(Mill Bypass Road, near IHS KMU)

Important Instructions

Download your roll number slip from the official ETEA website:

https://etea.one/roll_no_section/

Enter your CNIC number (without dashes) to access your slip.

No separate call letters will be issued.

Follow all instructions mentioned on the roll number slip strictly.

Regularly visit the University and ETEA websites for updates.

Test Composition

Section | Weightage
Relevant Subject | 70%
English | 10%
Basic Computer | 10%
General Knowledge | 10%
